about: FR-49/51/52/53 reflex and clock knobs (docs/v2/CONTRACTS.md §9.18). The kernel reads this file at boot (K.cfg.reflex); a missing or invalid file or key means the built-in defaults shown here. Actions: clock (timestream off, FPS cap at clock.siege_cap), gates (every linked drawbridge up), doors (entrance doors forbidden: next to open sky and on seal's entrance routes), alert (civ alert; seal picks the burrow: Kern+, else Innen+, kept for the lockdown). gate (BUG-027): every pull waits while a unit that is not hostile stands on or next to the footprint; force_near = tiles (0-30, 0 never) a visible hostile must be from the footprint before a SIEGE/BREACH raise goes ahead onto such a unit (GATE_FORCED); manual = bridge names (B1) or building ids (17880) that get no automatic pull at all (stop-gap: the bridge then stays down in a siege, GATE_FAIL manual, BREACH at T+900 for an outer/inner one).
